title: I have lived a life not polite to scribe in common circles so I must mask my truth in false cellophane of overstretched metaphors #smallpoems
summary: I have lived a life not polite to scribe in common circles so I must mask my truth in false cellophane of overstretched metaphors #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I have lived
a life not
polite to scribe
in common circles
so I must
mask my truth
in false cellophane
of overstretched
metaphors
#smallpoems
